mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT('OPERATION:', id) AS document_id, 'TICKET' AS kind, 'OPERATION' AS source, id AS source_id, ticket_id, operator_id, action, content, created_at FROM ticket_operation_logs WHERE id > #{afterId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT CONCAT('STATUS:', id) AS document_id, 'TICKET' AS kind, 'STATUS' AS source, id AS source_id, ticket_id, operator_id, CONCAT('STATUS_', event) AS action, CONCAT('状态变更：', COALESCE(from_status, '无'), ' → ', to_status, CASE WHEN remark IS NULL OR remark = '' THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('（', remark, '）') END) AS content, created_at FROM ticket_status_history WHERE id > #{afterId} AND from_status IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT CONCAT('CONFIGURATION:', id) AS document_id, 'CONFIGURATION' AS kind, 'CONFIGURATION' AS source, id AS source_id, operator_id, config_key, before_value, after_value, created_at FROM configuration_change_logs WHERE id > #{afterId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
